Not. The typical charge for bank staff forging documents to obtain loans is "职务侵占罪" (embezzlement) and "诈骗罪". The prosecution may charge "职务侵占罪" and "诈骗罪" (数额巨大). Could also be "非法占有他人财物罪"? But we stick to law.
